answer: The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, reduced by each unverified claim, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the sparrow of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The onyx holds work receipts rather than names, so the island of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short.
